text:
sam-partners: Heads up  LatticeHealth just finalized an ISV bundle on Azure Marketplace that includes Redwood Dedicated as the recommended inference backend. They committed to a 36-month reserved plan + optional Private VPC. Go-live window targeted for May 10. Big door-opener into care mgmt vertical. :tada:

olivia: Fantastic! Did legal sign off on the co-marketing language?

sam-partners: Yes, copy approved. Marcus, you asked for a customer quote  want to nudge Lattice's CTO for 1-sentence praise about latency/ops?

marcus-marketing: On it. I'll request logo rights and a 15-25 word quote. Suggest we aim for a short blog + marketplace spotlight the week after launch.

mike-eng: Engineering ask: we should publish an "Azure marketplace quickstart" that wires the Dedicated connector + example infra. I'll draft a terraform snippet and a tiny nodejs example for the listing. Also need to confirm p95 latency targets for their expected workload (medical triage models): token lengths ~200-400, qps ~8-12 per tenant.

sophia-sec: From security: because they process PHI in parts, we need a signed BAA, HSM-backed KMS for customer keys if requested, and audit retention set to 1 year. I'll attach the checklist to the ticket.

onboard-bot: Onboarding ticket MH-5510 created for LatticeHealth. Assigned: mike-eng, ETA 7 days.

mike-eng: Thanks bot. For the quickstart, draft perf blurb: "p95 token latency <60ms on reserved g6 configs for typical triage flows; batching profiles optimized for seq=256-512." Cost blurb: "20-35% lower unit cost vs self-managed with our recommended batch/cache profiles."

olivia: Can engineering add a 3-line code snippet for the marketplace tile? Keep it tiny. Marketing prefers JS or Python.

mike-eng: Tiny JS snippet (5 lines):
```js
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference';
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RWD_KEY });
const res = await client.generate({ model: 'rwd-qa-1', prompt: 'Summarize patient symptoms' });
console.log(res.text);
```

marcus-marketing: Perfect. Also can we get a one-liner "why Lattice picked Redwood" from product? Short bullets: private deployment options, predictable cost, and support for HSM keys.

sam-partners: I'll draft it: "Chose Redwood for private deployment & key isolation plus predictable reserved pricing and proven latency for clinical flows."

sophia-sec: Uploaded BAA + KMS integration guide to the ticket. I'm tagging compliance for review.

mike-eng: Quick infra note: we'll pre-provision a small test Dedicated pool (2 nodes) in their region for perf validation the week before go-live. Ops: please confirm capacity window.

onboard-bot: Capacity reservation request submitted. Ticket OPS-2241.

olivia: Logistics: Marcus, could you own the external announcement calendar? We'll avoid competing press the following week.

marcus-marketing: Yep, I'll book the slot and loop in PR.

sam-partners: Thanks team. Welcome LatticeHealth aboard  big strategic match. I'll post the intro email to the customer once we finalize the kickoff time. :raised_hands:
